**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the one view defined in `workspace.dsl`.

A note on how I got here, since it affects what you're looking at:

- I parsed and validated the DSL with the Structurizr tools and exported the `SystemContext` view to PlantUML.
- This environment has **no internet, no renderer** (no node/python/java/plantuml), and **no root** to install one — so I couldn't run a real PlantUML/Mermaid render to PNG.
- Since you allowed SVG, I hand-built a clean, C4-styled SVG directly from the exported view definition.

What the diagram shows (correct for a *system context* view — containers are intentionally not shown at this level):
- **Patron** `[Person]` — "Borrows books at the library."
- **Library** `[Software System]` — "Manages books and loans."
- Relationship: **Patron → Library** — "Browses the catalogue through" `[HTTPS]`

It uses the standard C4 palette (person `#084270`, software system `#1168bd`) and opens in any browser or image viewer.

If you'd prefer a **PNG** or a **real PlantUML/Mermaid render** (e.g., to get the exact auto-layout), let me know — that would need a renderer available (internet access or a local `plantuml`/`node` install). I can also add the **container view** (Catalog Web App + Circulation Service) as a second image if you want that level of detail rendered too.
